title: Senior IT Support
description:
Position: Senior IT Support  
Location: Kochi,India / Sharjah, UAE (supporting UAE \& India offices)  
Reports to: Management

Role Overview

The Senior IT Support will be responsible for managing and securing the company’s IT infrastructure across all offices. This includes server administration, network and security management, user support, license compliance, data privacy, and IT policy implementation. The role requires strong technical expertise, leadership, and vendor coordination to ensure smooth operations, security, and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure \& Server Management

* Manage Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policies.
* Oversee file servers, QNAP devices, backups, and storage integration.
* Ensure uptime, performance, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Plan and implement system upgrades and patches.

Network \& Security

* Administer Fortinet firewalls, VPNs (FortiClient), and secure tunneling across offices.
* Monitor network health, connectivity, and performance.
* Define and enforce security policies (USB restrictions, file permissions, password policies).
* Manage endpoint protection, antivirus, and monitoring tools.

User \& Application Support

* Provide IT support to 60\+ users across UAE and India.
* Manage software deployment and license compliance (Microsoft 365, AutoCAD, ARES Commander, Bentley, etc.).
* Ensure seamless SSO / credential integration across systems.
* Maintain user access controls and prevent unauthorized data sharing.

Data Privacy \& Compliance

* Implement IT policies aligned with data protection and confidentiality standards.
* Monitor and audit IT activities for compliance.
* Support ISO\-related IT documentation (policies, SOPs, forms).

Monitoring \& Reporting

* Use IT monitoring tools for system, network, and hardware health checks.
* Maintain logs of IT activities, incidents, and preventive actions.
* Provide regular IT performance and security reports to management.

Vendor \& Project Management

* Coordinate with IT vendors for hardware, software, and service contracts.
* Lead IT projects (server upgrades, AD migration, cloud integration, etc.).
* Evaluate and recommend new technologies for cost\-effective adoption.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* Windows Server 2025 \& Active Directory
* Group Policy Management
* Microsoft 365 / Azure AD
* Networking (LAN/WAN, VPN, Fortinet firewalls)
* NAS/Storage systems (QNAP)
* Experience in server virtualization, backup solutions, and endpoint management.
* Familiarity with IT security frameworks, ISO standards, and data protection practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and leadership skills.
* Ability to lead IT initiatives independently and train junior staff.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Service Desk Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:** ServiceDesk Coordinator (Helpdesk coordinator)

**Location:** Kochi

**Job Summary:**

The Service Desk Coordinator is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the day\-to\-day activities of the IT service desk or help desk team. They play a key role in ensuring that customer issues and technical support requests are addressed promptly and efficiently.

**Main Responsibilities:**

**Team Supervision:**

· Manage a team of service desk technicians or support staff.

· Provide guidance, coaching, and training to team members.

· Monitor team performance and ensure adherence to service level agreements (SLAs).

**Ticket Management:**

· Receive, prioritize, and assign service requests and incidents to appropriate team members.

· Ensure accurate and timely documentation of all tickets.

· Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution and escalation as needed.

**Customer Support:**

· Act as the point of contact for customers and end\-users seeking technical assistance.

· Respond to customer inquiries and resolve technical issues promptly.

· Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction through effective communication and problem\-solving.

**Process Improvement:**

· Identify opportunities to improve service desk processes and workflows.

· Implement best practices to enhance efficiency and customer service.

· Document and update standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Technical Knowledge:**

· Stay up\-to\-date with IT industry trends and technologies.

· Provide technical guidance and expertise to team members when needed.

· Assist with complex technical issues and escalations.

**Reporting and Metrics:**

· Generate reports on service desk performance, including ticket volumes, response times, and resolution rates.

· Analyze data to identify trends and areas for improvement.

· Prepare regular reports for management.

**Vendor and Asset Management:**

· Manage relationships with IT vendors and service providers.

· Assist in procurement and asset management activities as necessary.

**Security and Compliance:**

· Ensure compliance with security policies and procedures.

· Assist in incident response and security\-related tasks as required.

**General Responsibilities:**

· Maintain and update configuration documents.

· Maintain assets and software licenses/subscriptions.

· Vendor coordination and support

**Qualification:**

· Graduate or above

· 1\+ years of total experience

· ManageEngine service desk application (Optional)

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Familiarity with the ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) framework is a plus.

**Skills:**

· Handling any service desk ticketing tool.

· Ticket registration via Phone and email

· Logging and categorization of tickets

· Assign the engineers.

· Prepare and submit monthly reports.

· Maintain SLAs and do timely escalations.

· Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

· Ability to speak and write clearly and accurately in English.

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience? ( 1\-2yrs)
* What is your current ctc?
* What is your Expected ctc?

Work Location: In person
